Tools / 01

Plan fabric length for repeated panels

Enter one panel's cut dimensions, count, usable fabric width and extra length you choose. The tool does not rotate pieces or match prints.

Planning result—

Enter numbers and calculate. Values stay in your browser.

Formula and limits

Pieces/row = floor(usable width ÷ cut width). Rows = ceil(piece count ÷ pieces/row). Planned length = rows × cut length + extra length.

One rectangular cut size, one orientation and uniform rows only. Does not simulate print matching, grain, defects, shrinkage or shop cut sizes.
